Stock market news | FII inflows hit ₹1.29 lakh crore in November

Foreign Institutional Investors poured ₹1,29,579 crore into Indian markets in November, matching reports of a ₹1.29 lakh crore surge.

The large inflow shows strong foreign interest, but market momentum has slowed, raising questions for investors.
